bins.unassigned: mapping or CrystalNN failure, or CN < 2 (reason cn<2)

definition.cn: non-O neighbours of the vacancy oxygen, pymatgen CrystalNN() defaults, pristine unit cell (data/processed/unit_cells_v1.json) at the mapped atom
definition.host_mean_cn: mean CN over the host's universe sites with a CN (descriptive)

cell_info.rule: sha256 over lines '<formula>/cell_info.txt:<sha256>' in host_id order

supercell_cifs.rule: sha256 over lines '<formula>/supercell.cif:<sha256>' in host_id order

payload.label: cation coordination number of the vacancy oxygen in the pristine host (CrystalNN defaults on the unit cell of data/processed/unit_cells_v1.json), site-level bins 2, 3, 4, 5+; fixed before any gain

release_coordination.rule: cations within the cutoff radius of cell_info.txt (descriptive comparison only)
